SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

4. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   B. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   D. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   B. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

6. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   B. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   D. Treat The School as rumours only.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

9. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   C. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

11. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   D. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   C. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   D. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   D. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Interdependence of people and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
